currentLaw.permitRule: Current plan explicitly prohibits conversion to kamerbewoning and woningsplitsing without omgevingsvergunning in the applicable rule areas.
currentLaw.applicationRequirements: Current plan contains special application requirements including a site drawing with at least two streets, legal-existing floor plans with room functions, proposed floor plans with new room/unit functions, on-site parking drawing if present, parking-norm calculator result and authorization when an agent applies.
currentLaw.assessment: Permit is granted only if the change does not cause unacceptable harm to residential/living climate; current 2026 policy is the assessment framework.
currentLaw.policy: Beleidsregels kamerbewoning en woningsplitsing Eindhoven 2026, CVDR748084, current from 01-01-2026.

substantiveRules.opSlotNewInitiatives: New kamerbewoning/woningsplitsing remains prohibited in specified op-slot areas; 2026 transition route is only for qualifying long-existing situations.
substantiveRules.thirtyMeterRule: Outside the centre, a 30-metre concentration rule applies subject to the 2026 policy exceptions, including specified upper-floor situations.
substantiveRules.liveability: Applications are assessed for liveability; municipal information states advice is given by the leefbaarheidscommissie.
substantiveRules.parking: Current parking norms apply and the parking calculator result should be included.
substantiveRules.housingQuality: Assessment includes housing-quality considerations such as unit dimensions, daylight, neighbouring privacy and sound-reduction measures.

application.route: Omgevingsloket; conceptverzoek can be used first to test feasibility. One application can cover plan-deviation/use and building where both are required.
documents: situatietekening with at least two streets
floor plans of existing legal situation with functions
floor plans of proposed situation with functions/rooms/units
drawing of parking possibilities on own site where present
application.additionalEvidence: 2026 published permit dossiers show that real transition applications can also contain a leefbaarheidsformulier and parking calculation; these are retained as evidence of case/application practice rather than generalized blindly to every branch.
application.conceptRequest: Can include an Omgevingsplan check, traffic check and/or appearance/welstand check; municipality aims to respond within 8 weeks.
application.decisionPeriod: Municipal woningsplitsing page states usually within 8 weeks, with one possible 6-week extension; incomplete applications suspend the clock.

transition2026.period: 01-01-2026 through 31-12-2026 application window for qualifying long-existing cases in original op-slot areas
transition2026.rule: Does not reopen these areas for new initiatives; only qualifying existing situations may seek legalization under the transition conditions.
transition2026.evidence: Current 2026 municipal publication dossiers confirm granted transition permits for existing kamerbewoning.

fees.rule: Municipal product and concept-request pages point to Legesverordening 2026. Exact amount is not stored until the correct current tariff-table activity line is positively verified; withdrawal/refusal can lead to partial refund according to municipal product information.

currentnessQA.oldPolicy2021: Expired 01-01-2026 and not used as current policy.
currentnessQA.transitionExpiry: The special 2026 transition application window is time-limited and must be removed/rechecked from 01-01-2027.
currentnessQA.futureWatch: Policy/plan cross-references should be rechecked when the 2026 transition expires or current Omgevingsplan articles are renumbered/updated.

remainingAllowedOnly: live application branch and case-specific additional studies
exact current fee line from the applicable 2026 tariff table
